name: Sprite
description: Spritesheets (grids, Aseprite and TexturePacker JSON with trimmed and rotated frames, tags and slices, loadable in the background) and animation clips (fps or per-frame durations, loop, once and pingpong, chained clips, frame events, promises), animated sprites with origin, scale, rotation and flip, batched drawing, and batch animation of TileMap sprites, all advanced in C by the Loop.
